  const b = BIRTHDAYS[id]

  const b = BIRTHDAYS[id]

  const year = SEASON_DAYS * 4
  const inYear = SEASON_ORDER.indexOf(b[0]) * SEASON_DAYS + b[1]
  const start = day - ((day - 1) % year)
  const d = start + inYear - 1
  return d >= day ? d : d + year
}
